heading_en: Application for Approval Regarding Trading Desks Using the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式を用いるトレーディング・デスクの設置に係る承認申請書の記載事項及び添付書類を定める。
summary_en: Sets the approval requirement for establishing trading desks that use the internal model approach, and the contents and attachments of the application.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under Article 250 may establish trading desks where it has obtained the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under the preceding paragraph shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for managing the trading desk.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval under the preceding paragraph. (i) A curriculum vitae of the person responsible prescribed in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (ii) A document showing that each trading desk satisfies the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (3) of the preceding Article. (iii) A document stating other matters that should be used for reference.
